notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard negotiated attribute divestiture cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies a pending acquisition, negotiated divestiture, cancellation, the ordinary release path, ownership retention, and cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, cancelNegotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, and ownership-query services with standard ownership callbacks
